summary: Fail. One blocker: page.tsx:115 passes graph.legBar ('Leg {n}') to next-intl with no value, which breaks design rule 11. The development build then logs FORMATTING_ERROR and shows a key path in each leg row. All other checked contracts hold: 57 of 57 PR section 6 keys in en, th, and zh, the D-19 images and alts, the five gallery slots, the calculator flow, and a clean lint of the five touched source files. Three nits.
blocking_findings: C-P3-1 [Blocker] review-c: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/products/tutor-advantage/page.tsx:115 requests graph.legBar with no value, but the string is 'Leg {n}' (locale file lines 197, 535, 875). Design rule 11 (docs/design-rules.md:28) requires t(key, { n: '{n}' }). In the development build of use-intl 4.13.0, a bare call logs FORMATTING_ERROR and returns the key path. Each leg row then shows 'pages.products.tutorAdvantage.calculator.graph.legBar' instead of 'Leg 1' in en, th, and zh. The production build keeps '{n}' raw, so the label works there only because of the build variant. No test can fail on the bare call, because the translator mocks (src/test/setup.ts:45) ignore values. Fix: pass { n: '{n}' } for legBar, widen the key helper type to accept values, and add a page test whose translator mock throws on a missing placeholder value. Precedent: commit b351f4f2e and src/components/marketing/mastery-graph-labels.ts:13. Evidence: node run of createTranslator with and without --conditions=development.
nonblocking_findings: C-P3-2 [Nit] review-c: measure/tracks/www_tutor_calculator_20261117/spec.md D-9 items 3 and 4 (lines 245-252) and the section 5.3 props block (lines 483-496) still name chart.legPayout, chart.legVolume, chart.yourPayout, directTutors, and downline. C-P3-3 [Nit] review-c: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/components/marketing/tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:163-168 resizes the legs on every change of the leg-count field. An empty field gives readNumber('') = 0 (:108-111), so Backspace drops all leg rows and the typed leg students. The next digit restores the default of 3 students per leg (resizeLegs, src/lib/tutor-commission.ts:220-231; module run: resizeLegs([4,5],0) = [] and resizeLegs([],2) = [3,3]). Keep the entries while the field is empty, or resize only on a whole number of 1 or more. Found by code reading and a module run, not in a browser.

C-P3-4 [Nit] review-c: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/products/tutor-advantage/page.tsx:193 replaced the hero SiteImageView, which had priority, with ProductPicture, and src/components/products/product-picture.tsx:13-31 has no priority prop. next/image then sets loading=lazy on the hero picture, a likely largest-paint element at lg width. Next dev can warn that an LCP image lacks priority. Add an optional priority prop to ProductPicture and set it for the hero. Found by code reading (diff hunk at page.tsx:190-196), not in a browser.
